program:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g))
                (bg 7)
                (objs (objects g bg)))
           (reduce (lambda (acc obj)
                     (let* ((bb (obj-bbox obj))
                            (r1 (first bb))
                            (c1 (second bb))
                            (r2 (third bb))
                            (c2 (fourth bb))
                            (bh (+ 1 (- r2 r1)))
                            (bw (+ 1 (- c2 c1)))
                            (solid (= (obj-size obj) (* bh bw)))
                            (marks (if solid
                                       (append (map (lambda (c) (list (- r1 1) c))
                                                    (range c1 (+ c2 1)))
                                               (map (lambda (c) (list (+ r2 1) c))
                                                    (range c1 (+ c2 1)))
                                               (map (lambda (r) (list r (- c1 1)))
                                                    (range r1 (+ r2 1)))
                                               (map (lambda (r) (list r (+ c2 1)))
                                                    (range r1 (+ r2 1))))
                                       (list (list (- r1 1) c1)
                                             (list (- r1 1) c2)
                                             (list (+ r2 1) c1)
                                             (list (+ r2 1) c2)
                                             (list r1 (- c1 1))
                                             (list r2 (- c1 1))
                                             (list r1 (+ c2 1))
                                             (list r2 (+ c2 1))))))
                       (if (and (= bh bw) (>= bh 2))
                           (reduce (lambda (a p)
                                     (let* ((r (first p))
                                            (c (second p)))
                                       (if (and
                                             (>= r 0)
                                             (< r h)
                                             (>= c 0)
                                             (< c w)
                                             (= (at g r c) bg))
                                           (set-cell a r c 2)
                                           a)))
                                   acc
                                   marks)
                           acc)))
                   g
                   objs))))
